_comment: Seeds the Work/Part coverage model and enables citation on the six TrackType.Canon tracks (Source Material References / Canon References across Character, Bond, Organization, World Law, Civilizational System, Technology -- ids confirmed live against TLTT v2.storyplan). MLP:FiM (all 221 numbered episodes + movie/specials/clip-shows), Equestria at War (all 79 playable countries, 3-letter game tags), The Princess and the Kaiser, and Pax Chrysalia were seeded from real reference material Brian supplied in source_material_references/ (gitignored -- Wikipedia's episode list, the EaW wiki's country list, and each Fimfiction chapter list) rather than guessed. Where a Fimfiction chapter has no real title (Fimfiction shows only "Part N"), its Name is Brian's own adhoc short name from his personal tracking spreadsheet (The Princess and the Kaiser - Sheet1.csv); one chapter (P&K ch1) has neither and is left unnamed -- Code is its display fallback. Extend this file (idempotent re-run) or use the in-app '+ Add new' quick-add as coverage grows.
